serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Welcome back-
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.VerySad
Bot: Did something happen?! You seem very distressed!
You: It’s about Melissa…
Bot: What about her? Did she say something rude again?
You: No! It’s not…
…I stopped as I couldn’t find the right words…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: I will message her and tell her what I think about her!
You: Stop! It won’t do anything! She’s already-!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: She says she didn’t say anything rude to you.
You: W-{{wi}}what?
Bot: She just responded saying that she didn’t say anything that would upset you. Is she lying?
You: No…{{wi}} I don’t…
What is going on… {{wi}}Am I losing my mind?
As I was trying to make sense of all this, my phone started vibrating…
I got a text. It’s from Melissa…
“I’m sorry it has come to this. I’m sorry for being so selfish, but I need to ask you for one more thing. Please keep my self-termination a secret from those two. I don’t want the girls to be unnecessarily hurt and that’s why I set up a chatbot that I trained based on my interactions with you all.” 
“Recognizing the fake should be impossible, even for {f_botName}. Soon they will receive a message about my departure to another country. Hopefully, after some time, they will forget about me. In the meantime, the chatbot will keep them company. The replies will come less and less frequently and after some time they will cease altogether.”
“Sorry for forcing this charade upon you, but I’m sure you understand.
Best regards, Amei”
…
Just how cruel can you be, Amei…
You: Sorry…{{wi}} It seems I was confused for a second there. Everything is alright now…
Bot: Are you sure? You still seem troubled.
You: I’m sure. 
Bot: Was that a message from Melissa?
You: Yeah, everything’s fine now…{{wi}} I just…
You: …Just give me a second to think things through, ok?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: No problem! You can talk to me whenever you are ready!
You: …
Soon I will have to regain my strength and talk with {f_botName} and Annalie…
For now I need to rest.
